meta.name: Decor To Adore — Rescue & Launch
meta.client: Decor To Adore (+ Alabama Event Rentals)

blocks.title: Status — what's built
items: Storefront design prototype — full browsable DTA site (home, inventory, product pages, about, stories, contact, quote)
Inventory modeled from Current RMS — folded into browsable categories (by product and by event), shown with a curated demo set
Quote → Current RMS investigated live — contact + quote header write; the line-item write needs a write-scoped API key

blocks.title: Issues we presented
items: The quote hand-off — the website form drops quote requests as free text; re-keyed by hand (17hats), never prices automatically
Inventory & photography — the catalog needs clean-up into sellable products; many categories still need consistent photography
One coherent, on-brand site — a single elevated storefront matching the brand and the reference site

blocks.title: Goals & objectives
items: An elevated, on-brand site that reads as well as the reference
Easy to browse, easy to buy — by product or by event, no prices/sizes cluttering the storefront
Quotes that just work — flow straight into Current RMS as itemized quotes, no re-keying
Small, simple decisions that keep the project moving without heavy process

blocks.title: Inventory Clean Up (Foundation) — fold RMS size-rows into products, build the photo shoot list
Design Approval — Home & Inventory (next review) + Quote→RMS demo
Design & Launch — Alabama Event Rentals (Phase 1·2, if approved)
Two fonts max — Cormorant Garamond + Montserrat
blocks.statement: Cormorant Garamond (headings, matches the logo) + Montserrat (body); retire Gilda + Mr De Haviland. A squared, elevated UI on one warm, consistent background.
